intent_en: To illustrate that younger generations are the primary drivers of Black migration to the South, supporting the narrator's explanation about increased educational opportunities for newer generations.
previous_intent: To illustrate that young adults have the highest rate of migration to the South, supporting the narrator's explanation that younger generations since the 1960s are moving for advanced education.
narration_support: I attribute some of it to younger generations... who now do have an opportunity to get advanced education.
chart_support: Bar chart showing Black migration rates by age, with the 18-29 age group highlighted as the largest segment.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly links migration to younger generations and education. The chart visualizes this by highlighting the 18-29 age bracket (typically college age) as having the highest migration rate/share, directly supporting the narrator's claim.
